company.name: Reevo
company.shortDescription: Reevo is an AI-native revenue operating system that integrates marketing, sales, and customer success into a unified platform.
company.description: Reevo offers an integrated sales platform that supports go-to-market teams through every stage of the revenue process, from prospecting and outreach to deal closing and post-sale management. It enables users to source and enrich target accounts, run multi-channel sequences, handle email deliverability and dialing, capture meeting recordings and insights, and manage pipelines and forecasts all within a unified interface. Reevo also embeds native AI tools that surface next steps, draft follow-ups, and provide contextual insights across customer interactions so that sales activity is tied directly to meaningful outcomes.
